test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends – L, M, N, O, D, E, and F – are seated around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). O is sitting fifth to the right of L. M has F and O as immediate neighbours. N and L are immediate neighbours of E. Who is sitting to the immediate left of D?
solution:
Given, Seven friends – L, M, N, O, D, E, and F – are seated around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

O is sitting fifth to the right of L.

M has F and O as immediate neighbours.
